gen-gf-tektur-gf-cal-sans: Tektur's pipe-cleaner strokes and generous curve endings give its oversized lowercase an expressive look. Cal Sans keeps paragraphs approachable, one stroke width throughout and a tall x-height under short ascenders.
gen-gf-tektur-gf-changa: Changa gives its lowercase the stature of cast iron capitals, which feels modern. Changa keeps a block of text clean and sturdy, while Tektur's tails and terminals match its stems in thickness.
gen-gf-tektur-gf-epunda-sans: Tektur draws every line with ruler-straight weight, giving its outsized lowercase and generously opened curves an expressive, distinctive look. Epunda Sans reads smoothly, its big a and e counters letting light in.
gen-gf-tektur-gf-jaldi: Tektur leads with monoline strokes and generous openings on every curve, an expressive heading with outsized lowercase. Jaldi's tightly brushed letters and tall x-height sit comfortably beneath all that expression.
gen-gf-tektur-gf-krona-one: Loosely spaced letters and a lowercase with the stature of cast iron capitals make Krona One feel approachable. Krona One keeps a full page easy going, while Tektur's joins hold their thickness where strokes meet.
gen-gf-tektur-gf-mukta: Punchy, expressive lowercase in oversized proportions, with Tektur's crossbars matching its stems and curves opening generously. Mukta keeps paragraphs clean and easy on the eye, thanks to tall-bodied small letters.
gen-gf-tektur-gf-noto-sans-display: Noto Sans Display reads approachably, its big, tall middle zone in every word keeping lowercase easy to follow. Yet Tektur's single stroke width and generous curve openings supply the expressive edge.
gen-gf-tektur-gf-port-lligat-sans: Pure show: Tektur's outsized lowercase and curves that match its stems. Where Tektur shows off, Port Lligat Sans quietly packs modern letters close as pins in a cushion, with barely a step from capitals to lowercase.
gen-gf-tektur-gf-rambla: Cord-like curves, generous openings and oversized lowercase make Tektur expressive and distinctive from the first glance. Rambla's small letters stand nearly capital height, so paragraphs stay clean and easy to follow.
gen-gf-tektur-gf-voces: Voces builds its lowercase tall, with stems and hairlines kept in a close ratio, neither wispy nor heavy. And Tektur's dowel-straight stems and bent-dowel arcs make an expressive foil for that measured restraint.
